name: Kosmos-869
about: Kosmos-869 (1976-114A), a crewed vehicle (7K-S), launched 1976 Nov 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1976 Dec  6), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
